errors.current: ـُوا = you all (ending of an order to a group: -ū)

errors.fix: تُعْطِي = you give (to a man); she gives

summary: Checked all 409 hand-glossary entries as dictionary glosses that override every tap app-wide, plus each transliteration against its harakat. 36 errors: 23 major, 13 minor. The dominant pattern (24 findings) is a sentence-specific '(wrong here — correct: …)' note used as the only gloss of a form that is perfectly valid elsewhere (أَحَد 'one', يَزُورُونَ, نَجَحُوا, أُعْلِنَ, بَنَتِ, the indicatives أَجِدُهَا/أَجْلِسُ/تُوقِظُنَا/أُسَجِّلُ, the nominatives الضَّجِيجُ/الطَّرِيقُ/الْمِفْتَاحُ/الْأَشْهَرُ, the genitive الْأَخْبَارِ, the duals طَبَقَانِ/تَذْكِرَتَانِ, إِنْتَرْنِت); these should carry the plain meaning, with the exercise-specific correction moved to the exercise's own seg. Separate real gloss errors: ـُوا glossed only as the imperative 'you all' though it is also the past 'they' ending; تُعْطِي glossed 'you give (to a woman)' instead of 'to a man / she gives'; سَمَحْتُمْ glossed as present; ـُ glossed as an iḍāfa marker only; تَأْمِين missing 'insurance'. Engine: الِا… keys transliterate as 'Iliā…' (3 keys), نَفْي as nafī, أَسْهَلُ as 'Ashalu'. The non-word mistake entries (غُرْفَةُهُ, طَالِبَةَانِ, زَارْنَا …), the pronoun/case-ending series, the grammar terms and the month names are correct.
